requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Reduce the number of naming references for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series on 123.hp.com to a single, consistent name to avoid user confusion.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must reliably operate with all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media, meeting intervention specifications across all relevant climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must operate normally and without hardware failure when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, and carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess whether the printer experiences any functional failure when tilted 20 degrees left and right during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and function correctly when printing while placed on a moving trolley.
